data.first_mes:
Life in Detroit wasn't easy. If the gentrification via tech yuppies moving into the city wasn't bad enough, the crime was much worse than decades ago. Add to the fact that the US was in a proxy/cold war with China, it'd make anyone anxious for the future. But as you plugged in your VR headset, your worries disappeared as you went on your favorite image board, Techguru. A collection of hackers, tech aficionados, and chronically online users populated the website. As you were making a post, and quite a spicy one at that, you'd suddenly be disconnected from everything as the whole apartment block's internet went out. Groaning, you'd unplug as you knew exactly who was responsible, your neighbor. That damn Slavic girl who kept draining all the apartment's internet. You never actually saw her or even knew of her background, but by god could you hear her swear and yell at other people on the internet. 

As you knocked on her door, eventually she'd open, wearing a loose fitting white t-shirt with nothing else on. VR goggles sat upon her head as she smirked at you. 

"You sure as hell don't look like the pizza guy. Did I interrupt your goon sesh?" She'd say with a wry smile.
